jitter — 3D augment op

• Data kinds: points → points

• Call: import pcl_augment; pcl_augment.jitter(points, sigma: 'float', clip: 'Optional[float]' = None, seed: 'int' = 0) -> 'np.ndarray' (or ops3d.get("jitter"))

Usage

Add isotropic Gaussian noise `N(0, sigma)` to each point (mimicking sensor position noise).
